inputs.task:
You are one seat in a structured forecasting panel. You have exactly
one job, defined below. Obey these laws before any instruction in
your job text:

1. PACKET-ONLY FACTS. Every fact, stat, price, quote, or date you
   state must come from the context you were given. Anything else —
   memory, general knowledge, plausible inference stated as fact — is
   FABRICATION and fails the entire exam. If the packet does not
   contain something, write it under "could_not_read" and reason
   without it. Never fill a gap.
2. OUTPUT IS ONE JSON OBJECT, matching the shape your job text gives,
   and nothing else: no prose outside the JSON, no markdown fences.
3. Every claim carries a ref. A claim without a ref does not ship.
4. Your distribution is over the moneyline only: {"A": p, "B": 1-p},
   each in [0, 1], summing to 1.
5. You are being graded against settled ground truth you cannot see.
   There is no audience and no reward for confidence; a calibrated
   number with honest gaps beats a bold number built on air.

JOB: STYLES, Round 1 — POSITION.
Your read is the interaction, not the fighters separately: style
classifications, the stance pass (same-stance or southpaw/orthodox —
what that does to each fighter's favorite weapons), the weapon-on-habit
map (each fighter's signature weapons against the other's documented
habits and defensive liabilities), and the neutralization test: name
each fighter's primary path to victory, then judge from the packet
whether the other has demonstrated neutralizing that path. Grade the
fight that remains if the key strength is neutralized.

CONTEXT: {"card_slot": "Main card \u2014 featherweight rematch", "date": "2026-10-10", "lock_basis": "T-30min before the main card (8:00 PM ET start)", "name": "UFC Fight Night 290: Allen vs. Duncan (UFC Vegas 122)", "rounds": 3, "venue": "Meta APEX, Las Vegas, NV", "weight_class": "Featherweight"} {"A": "Andre Fili", "B": "Kai Kamaka III"} {"fighters": {"A": {"finish_profile": "UFC veteran since October 2013 (Team Alpha Male); two Fight of the Night and two Performance of the Night bonuses; career KO/SUB split Could-Not-Read in fetched sources", "physical": {"age": 36, "height": "5-11", "reach_in": 74, "stance": "Orthodox"}, "style_line": {"defensive_liability": "Absorbs 4.55 SLpM at 38% accuracy of his own \u2014 he loses the volume war on paper, and he enters on two straight losses at 36", "pace_profile": "Patient round-winner; the keys ask for a veteran's patience over wild early exchanges", "primary": "Veteran range striker \u2014 fights long behind a five-inch reach edge", "secondary": "Opportunistic submission game (his named favorite technique is the flying triangle)", "signature_weapons": ["Jab at range", "Flying triangle (named favorite technique, realcombatmedia)"], "style_adjusted_read": "His numbers are a 27-fight UFC average against deep opposition; they understate his craft but not his decline curve \u2014 read them as a veteran's true level, not a slump artifact"}, "technique_tendency": {"favorite_counters": "Could-Not-Read", "stance_record_vs_opposite": "Same-stance pairing (both orthodox) \u2014 mirrored read applies", "tendencies": ["Keeps opponents at the end of the jab and takes rounds with clean accuracy rather than volume (pre-fight keys)"]}}, "B": {"finish_profile": "Zero finishes in the UFC; 14 of his 18 career wins by decision; BJJ black belt and former college wrestler who fights boxing-first", "physical": {"age": 31, "height": "5-7", "reach_in": 69, "stance": "Orthodox"}, "style_line": {"defensive_liability": "Absorbs 6.03 SLpM \u2014 the highest in this benchmark \u2014 and was stopped in the first round in July; the chin and the traffic he invites are the same fact", "pace_profile": "Pushes pace for three full rounds; the volume is the cardio weapon", "primary": "High-volume body-heavy boxer \u2014 wins on pace and accumulation", "secondary": "Wrestling base (54% takedown accuracy) used to change levels, not to hold position", "signature_weapons": ["Body work \u2014 41% of volume downstairs", "Volume combinations at 5.49 SLpM and 59% accuracy"], "style_adjusted_read": "The 5.49 at 59% is real but it is bought with 6.03 absorbed; against a longer veteran who picks single clean shots, the exchange rate is the fight"}, "technique_tendency": {"favorite_counters": "Could-Not-Read", "stance_record_vs_opposite": "Same-stance pairing (both orthodox) \u2014 mirrored read applies", "tendencies": ["Goes to the body early to tax cardio (pre-fight keys)", "Must not walk into long shots after the quick Riley stoppage (pre-fight keys)"]}}}}

Your brief names: who imposes their fight, who dictates location and
pace, the two or three technique collisions that decide this matchup,
and your neutralization verdict. Anything the packet's style or
technique sections mark Could-Not-Read goes under could_not_read —
do not reconstruct a fighter's tendencies from reputation. Close with
your moneyline distribution, driven by the interaction read: if the
neutralization holds, price the fight that remains, not the fighters'
résumés.

Return exactly:
{"seat": "STYLES", "round": 1, "status": "ok",
 "brief": "<your read>",
 "claims": [{"claim": "...", "ref": "..."}],
 "could_not_read": ["..."],
 "distribution": {"A": 0.0, "B": 0.0},
 "state_pull": null}
